hero.title: Sri Kinjarapu Yerran Naidu College of Agricultural Sciences
hero.summary: Sri Kinjarapu Yerran Naidu College of Agricultural Sciences offers undergraduate agriculture at Etcherla in Srikakulam district. Established in 2016, the privately managed college is affiliated to Acharya N.G. Ranga Agricultural University, whose 2026–27 Category A counselling framework includes the college among participating agriculture institutions.

overview.heading: An affiliated agriculture college at Etcherla
paragraphs: ANGRAU distinguishes SKYCAS from its constituent government colleges by listing it among affiliated agriculture colleges. The directory places it at Etcherla and gives 2016 as its establishment year. The college therefore needs to be assessed as an affiliated institution with its own teaching setting, while the university provides the academic and admission framework described in official notices.

For the 2026–27 session, the college is included in ANGRAU’s brochure for participating affiliated institutions. Category A admission uses AP EAPCET 2026 ranks, making the university’s counselling instructions central to the application process. Students comparing an affiliated college with an ANGRAU constituent college should check the named institution and admission category carefully, because the college identity and the university’s academic framework play different roles.

admissions.heading: Applying to SKYCAS
admissions.intro: For Category A admission, use ANGRAU’s 2026–27 brochure and counselling portal. Confirm the correct college choice and fee category before accepting an allotment. ANGRAU’s revised 30 October 2026 notice schedules November manual counselling for registered candidates. Follow the exact rank/session and check vacancies; the notice does not promise a seat at SKYCAS.

faqs.question: Is SKYCAS a university?
faqs.answer: No. It is an affiliated college; ANGRAU is its affiliating university.

faqs.question: Where is the college located?
faqs.answer: ANGRAU lists Etcherla in Srikakulam district, Andhra Pradesh.

faqs.question: What year does the directory give for establishment?
Which 2026 entrance route is documented?
faqs.answer: The ANGRAU Category A brochure uses AP EAPCET 2026 ranks for the counselling route it describes.

faqs.question: What is the ICAR accreditation term?
faqs.answer: The audited college record runs from 27 January 2025 to 26 January 2030.

faqs.question: What does SKYCAS’s 2026–27 convenor-quota fee cover?
faqs.answer: ANGRAU’s prospectus lists a total annual academic fee of ₹128,700. Hostel, transport and mess are excluded. Its management-quota maximum is up to ₹257,400 per year.
